description: We, the undersigned residents, business owners, and community stakeholders of Georgia House District 105 and the surrounding Buford/Mall of Georgia area, strongly oppose any current or future proposal by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to convert a warehouse near the Mall of Georgia into a federal processing or detention facility.
